provenance: Curated from primary papers, official repositories, model hubs, project pages, and explicit licence or access terms. The 2026-11-06 local preview follows the October catalog with discovery lanes for all ten modalities, a calibrated-uncertainty lane and a candidate-feed/watchlist/rename lane, a second-agent review of every October discovery lead and of every held record, and a separate adversarial review of every proposed addition and promotion. It adds 52 records, promotes 0 previously held records, moves 0 records to the under-review register, places 40 reviewed leads on that register, and corrects stale access, repository and publication details on existing records. The canonical displayed catalog contains 538 records; 77 unresolved candidates remain in the separate under-review register. Unchanged rows retain their prior verification dates. Generated distributions come from canonical JSON through a deterministic build. This preview has no published release reference.
evidence_statement: 538 records: 238 verified and 300 with visible limitations. November review covers new and promoted entries, targeted corrections, all previously held records and the October leads; older verification dates are preserved. 77 candidates remain under review. Check each record's access and licence limitations before use.
